purpose: Offline regression of recorded thermal/voltage response layouts for the owner's single Galax RTX 3060 12 GB. No acquisition, new profile, or cross-architecture module approval.

source_capture.evidence_kind: Previously recorded returned buffers; the fixture does not initiate a driver call.

separate_runtime_profile.relationship: A different module image with independent existing allowlisting. The x86 fixture is not evidence authorizing these x64 addresses or hashes.

extraction: For each selected sample, encode every raw_words entry in source order as one unsigned 32-bit little-endian word. Keep the complete 168/168/76-byte response, with no regenerated fields or native struct serialization.

expected.rounding: Nearest millidegree, halfway away from zero; expected values calculated from recorded Celsius using decimal rounding.

limitations: The positive exact-value assertions detect decoder code selecting the wrong recorded word or applying the wrong scale.
The negative cases test independently changed low-word size, upper-word revision, channel mask, and callback failure after complete or partial writes.
A driver that shifts data while retaining valid metadata can still expose plausible zeros or values. This fixture does not prove detection of arbitrary unseen layout drift.
No physical measurement, Linux NVAPI support, other GPU model, driver version, VBIOS, or module image is validated by replaying these buffers.
